stem: Why is Thomas Jefferson's writing of the Declaration of Independence considered to be one of his greatest contributions to American history?

options.label: A
options.text: He showed responsibility by outlining the structure for a new government.

options.label: B
options.text: He helped define rights that would defeat tyranny.

options.label: C
options.text: He developed a military plan to defeat the British.

options.label: D
options.text: He outlined a strategy for acquiring the Louisiana Territory.
